decisions.reason: The DPA management tool is cheap to carry, fits the firm's compliance and agency focus, and has positive though vague customer feedback, so the option is still worth holding.
The management platform is central to the firm's agency strategy and stayed on the home page in both years, which signals its value is being realized rather than resolved negatively.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business and costs little to keep on owned infrastructure, so there is little reason to drop it.
Extended PHP security support is new and its demand is still uncertain, and it may phase out as legacy PHP versions age, but its carrying cost is low enough to keep the option for now.
